messages.notALink: This isn't a web link. Links start with https://.
messages.unsupportedScheme: Potion Dropper downloads only web links (http and https).
messages.credentials: Links that contain a user name or password aren't supported.
messages.tooLong: This file is {minutes} minutes long. The limit in Settings is {limit} minutes.
messages.invalidHost: This link's site address isn't valid.
messages.invalidPort: This link's port number isn't valid.
messages.playlist: Potion Dropper can't download streaming playlists.
messages.notMedia: This link isn't an audio or video file.
messages.unsupportedSite: Potion Dropper can't download from this site.
messages.accessDenied: This file needs a sign-in or isn't public, so Potion Dropper can't download it.
messages.notFound: This file isn't on the site anymore. Check the link.
messages.unavailableForLegalReasons: The site says this file isn't available for legal reasons.
messages.rateLimited: The site is limiting downloads right now. Try again later.
messages.serverError: The site isn't answering right now. Try again later.
messages.tooLarge: This file is larger than the size limit in Settings.
messages.robotsDisallowed: This site asks apps not to download this file, so Potion Dropper won't.
messages.tooManyRedirects: This link redirects too many times.
messages.network: Can't reach the site. Check your internet connection.
messages.timedOut: The site stopped responding. Try again later.
messages.interrupted: The download stopped before it finished. Try again.
